module_form_detail: python -m autodev.cli --help exits 0 in all three venvs (editable, wheel, sdist). Output: 'Usage: python -m autodev.cli [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...'
console_script_caveat: console_script 'autodev' installs correctly in all paths; --help works everywhere. --version works ONLY in editable installs (source has it, dists do not).

warnings.detail: dist/ artifacts (wheel + sdist) were built from a stale source snapshot. src/autodev/cli.py is 1042 lines (has _version_callback + @app.callback); installed cli.py from both dist artifacts is 1019 lines (missing those 23 lines). autodev --version returns exit 2 from wheel/sdist installs.
python3 (3.14.4 Homebrew) has broken ensurepip — venv creation fails. pyproject.toml requires-python >=3.10, so 3.12 is fine, but this will surprise users whose system python3 is 3.14.
pip 26.0 installed; pip 26.1.1 available. Upgrade notice appears on all fresh installs but does not affect functionality.

findings.detail: Wheel and sdist in dist/ are stale: they were built before the --version CLI flag was added to src/autodev/cli.py. Rebuild dist artifacts with 'python -m build' (or hatch build) from current HEAD before release.

python3.14 (Homebrew) cannot create pip-enabled venvs due to broken ensurepip. All audit fresh-venv paths fell back to python3.12. Document python3.12 or python3.13 as the recommended interpreter for end-users on macOS until this Homebrew issue resolves.
